name: SMLB
description: Recently, self-supervised metric learning has raised attention for the potential to learn a generic distance function. It overcomes the limitations of conventional supervised one, e.g., scalability and label biases. Despite progress in this domain, current benchmarks, incorporating a narrow scope of classes, stop the nuanced evaluation of semantic representations. To bridge this gap, we introduce a large-scale benchmark with diversity and granularity of classes, Statistical Metric Learning Benchmark (SMLB) built upon ImageNet-21K and WordNet. SMLB is designed to rigorously evaluate the discriminative discernment and generalizability across more than 14M images, 20K classes, and 16K taxonomic nodes. Alongside, we propose novel evaluation metrics -- `overlap' for separability and `aSTD' for consistency -- to measure distance statistical information, which are efficient and robust to the change of class number. reputation: A niche but substantial benchmark for statistical metric learning, mainly used in research on representation quality rather than as a mainstream leaderboard.
notes: Large-scale non-LLM vision benchmark built on ImageNet-21K/WordNet; evaluates embedding statistics and separability/consistency rather than classification accuracy, so scores are not directly comparable to standard vision benchmarks.
